newsitem.title: USA: Werner in marketing pact with Hub Group.
newsitem.headline: Werner in marketing pact with Hub Group.

text.p: Werner Enterprises Inc on Monday said it signed a marketing agreement with Hub Group Inc that is expected to improve service to customers of both transportation providers.

Werner, which provides full transportation services, and Lombard, Illinois-based Hub Group, which offers intermodal and logistics services, said they saw a natural synergy in working together in certain areas.
The two companies expect to see future opportunities to market their services jointly to new customers, although further details were not immediately available.
Werner shares closed up 3/16 at 18-7/8, while Hub was nchanged at 27-1/2.
